name: RCore CRM
description: Manage leads, customers, sales activities and follow-ups from one platform.
problem: Sales teams lose track of who to call next, and managers cannot see what is in the pipeline.
solution: RCore CRM keeps every lead, conversation and follow-up in one place with a clear pipeline view.
faqQuestion: Can the pipeline stages be changed?
faqAnswer: Yes. Stages, fields and permissions can be adjusted to your sales process.

name: RCore ERP
description: Centralize business operations, resources and reporting.
problem: Operational data is scattered, so reports take days to prepare and are hard to trust.
solution: RCore ERP brings stock, sales, purchasing and people records into one connected system.
faqQuestion: Can we start with only one module?
faqAnswer: Yes. Most teams begin with a single module and expand.

name: RCore School
description: School management software for students, teachers, attendance, fees and administration.
problem: Student records, attendance and fee tracking often sit on paper or in separate sheets.
solution: RCore School gives administrators, teachers and parents one shared system for daily school work.
faqQuestion: Can parents see their child's information?
faqAnswer: A parent view can be enabled, limited to their own child's records.

name: RCore Business
description: Business management tools for growing companies.
problem: Growing companies outgrow notebooks and spreadsheets long before they are ready for a heavy ERP.
solution: RCore Business covers customers, sales, expenses and tasks in a lighter package.
faqQuestion: How is this different from RCore ERP?
faqAnswer: It is lighter and faster to adopt, aimed at smaller teams.

name: RCore Automation
description: Automation solutions that reduce repetitive manual work.
problem: Routine messages, reminders and data entry take time that nobody has.
solution: RCore Automation connects your tools and runs routine steps for you, with clear logs of what happened.
faqQuestion: Which tools can it connect to?
faqAnswer: We confirm the integrations during planning, based on the tools you use.
